title: Coverage Schedule of Routine Maintenance Items, Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan
content:
Each plan of the Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan is written around a fixed list of routine items. The first schedule below shows which of them the plan includes; the second shows the mileage intervals and the per-term counts the plan sets for them.

**Schedule 1 — items included**

| Plan | Oil and filter change | Tyre rotation | Multi-point inspection | Interior and exterior detail | Wiper blades and starter battery |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Keyturn Care Essentials Plan | Included | Included | Included | Not included | Not included |
| Keyturn Care Routine Plan | Included | Included | Included | Included | Included |
| Keyturn Care Complete Plan | Included | Included | Included | Included | Included |
| Keyturn Care Turnaround Plan | Included | Included | Included | Included | Included |
| Keyturn Care Fleet Plan | Included | Included | Included | Included | Included |
| Keyturn Care Electric Plan | Not included | Included | Included | Included | Included |

**Schedule 2 — intervals and counts**

| Plan | Miles between included oil changes | Miles between included tyre rotations | Multi-point inspections per term | Detail cleans per term |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Keyturn Care Essentials Plan | 5000 | 7500 | 1 | 0 |
| Keyturn Care Routine Plan | 5000 | 6000 | 2 | 1 |
| Keyturn Care Complete Plan | 6000 | 6000 | 2 | 2 |
| Keyturn Care Turnaround Plan | 6000 | 5000 | 4 | 4 |
| Keyturn Care Fleet Plan | 7500 | 7500 | 4 | 6 |
| Keyturn Care Electric Plan | 0 | 5000 | 3 | 3 |

*Footnote to schedule 2.* An interval of 0 miles and a count of 0 stand against the items the plan does not include: the Keyturn Care Electric Plan sets no oil change interval, being written without an oil and filter change, and the Keyturn Care Essentials Plan sets no detail cleans, being written without a detail.

*Footnote on the tyre rotation interval.* The interval is not read off the rank of the plan. The Keyturn Care Essentials Plan and the Keyturn Care Fleet Plan both set 7500 miles between included rotations, while the Keyturn Care Turnaround Plan and the Keyturn Care Electric Plan both set 5000.
